other_conditions: Individual farmers must not be defaulters to any bank
Individual farmers must have sufficient land in the name of the borrower or on lease, with the remaining lease period not less than the loan tenure
Individual farmers should have adequate experience or training for the activity they seek assistance for
Self‑Help Groups must adhere to the Panchasutra concept (regular meetings, regular savings, regular inter‑loaning, timely repayment, and up‑to‑date books of accounts)
Self‑Help Groups should be financed by the bank where they hold their bank account
Members of Self‑Help Groups must have sufficient land, either self‑owned or on lease, to carry out land‑based activities
Farmer Producer Organizations must be registered under the Societies Act, Co‑operative Societies Act or Company Act
FPOs must have at least three years of audited balance sheets
All board members and members of the FPO must be non‑defaulters to any bank or financial institution
FPOs must not be operating at a loss
FPOs must have at least 100 shareholders and a minimum paid‑up capital of Rs 1,00,000
The activity funded must be relevant to the prime activity of the FPO
Maximum borrowing by the FPO is restricted to two‑thirds of its paid‑up share capital or as per its bye‑laws
At least 80% of FPO members should participate in and benefit from the FPO through input supply or aggregation/marketing of produce
benefits_summary: Enhances farmers' and entrepreneurs' income by providing subsidised credit and support for agricultural, allied, and micro‑enterprise activities.
documents_required: Village Council land‑holding certificate countersigned by area administrative officer
